title: Numbers 4: Meet 'Two' (два and две, masculine and feminine)
titleRussian: Числа 4: знакомимся с числом 'два' (два и две, мужской и женский род)
description: The number two does something new: it reshapes the noun. Два брата, две сестры. Today we focus on just the masculine and feminine versions, with one ending change to learn at a time.
descriptionRussian: Числительное 'два' впервые меняет форму существительного: два брата, две сестры. Сегодня — только мужской и женский род, одно изменение за раз.
intro: Until now a number has sat beside a noun and left it alone. From here it reaches in and changes the noun's ending, and which ending you get depends on which number you used. Two is also the last number with a gender of its own, so it carries a small extra decision that three and four will not. Slow down on this one.
rules: Two reshapes the noun. The noun moves out of its dictionary form and into the genitive singular.
Masculine ending change: a consonant stem gains -а. Брат → брата. Кот → кота. Дом → дома.
Feminine ending change: -а switches to -ы. Сестра → сестры. Мама → мамы. (After к, г, х, ж, ш, ч, щ the ending is -и: книга → книги.)
Two has a gender. Два with masculine nouns; две with feminine nouns. Both have the same first syllable; only the last vowel differs.
Today is masculine and feminine only. Neuter, three, four, and the rest come in the next lessons, one piece at a time.
examples: У меня два брата. (I have two brothers.) Masculine: два + брата (gen sg).
У Лены две сестры. (Lena has two sisters.) Feminine: две + сестры (gen sg).
У Антона два кота. (Anton has two cats.) Masculine: два + кота.
У меня две машины. (I have two cars.) Feminine: две + машины.
На столе две книги. (There are two books on the table.) Feminine, with -и after к: две + книги.
У Маши два телефона. (Masha has two phones.) Masculine: два + телефона.

rows.label: feminine after к / г / х / hushers

items.promptEnglish: Recap from Lesson 3: I have one watch.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 3. Часы is a plural-only noun, so the form is 'одни'. From today onward, the other numbers reshape the noun instead of agreeing with it.
Брат is masculine. Два adds -а to the masculine consonant: брат → брата.

items.hint: Switch the -а ending of сестра to -ы.
items.explanation: Сестра is feminine. The -а of сестра switches to -ы: сестра → сестры. The form 'две' is the feminine version of two; together: две сестры.

items.hint: Кот is masculine. Add -а to the consonant.
items.explanation: Кот is masculine. Add -а: кот → кота.
Машина is feminine. Switch -а → -ы: машина → машины. The full phrase 'две машины' is feminine throughout: feminine two, feminine noun ending.

items.promptEnglish: There are two books on the table.
items.hint: Книга is feminine, and the stem ends in к: use -и, not -ы.
items.explanation: Книга is feminine, and its stem ends in к. The spelling rule (no -ы after к, г, х or hushers) gives -и instead: книга → книги. Same idea as in adjectives: русский, not русскый.

blanks: У меня два _____. (I have two phones.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Телефон is masculine. After 'два' the masculine consonant gains -а: телефон → телефона.

errorCorrection.explanation: Кот is masculine; the form for 'two' with a masculine noun is два, not две. Две is reserved for feminine nouns ('две сестры'). After picking the correct gender of 'two', the noun shifts to the genitive singular: кота.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There are two tables in the room.
errorCorrection.explanation: After два / две / три / четыре, the noun goes into the GENITIVE SINGULAR (not nominative plural, even though the meaning is plural). The gen sg of стол is стола.
After две (the feminine form of 'two'), the noun goes into the GENITIVE SINGULAR: подруги (gen sg of подруга, -а → -и after г).

minimalPairs.explanation: Брат is masculine, so the form is 'два'. 'Две' fits only feminine nouns like сестра.
Сестра is feminine, so the form is 'две'. Two is the only number besides one with a gender form.

reviewVocab.definition: genitive singular (the noun ending that два and две trigger: брата, сестры, машины)
reviewVocab.example: В словосочетании 'два брата' слово 'брата' стоит в родительном падеже единственного числа: окончание -а после согласной.

reviewVocab.definition: the feminine form of 'two'; used only with feminine nouns (две сестры, две книги, две машины)
reviewVocab.example: В словосочетании 'две сестры' слово 'две' — женский вариант числительного 2.

reviewVocab.definition: case government (the way a number imposes a particular case on the noun beside it; два and две govern the genitive singular)
reviewVocab.example: У числительного 'два' есть падежное управление: оно требует, чтобы существительное стояло в родительном падеже единственного числа.
